title: Trinity B002: Zero-DSP FPGA Architecture for Ternary Neural Inference
description:
Complete FPGA architecture for ternary neural network inference requiring zero DSP blocks. Key innovations: (1) Zero-DSP ternary MAC using pure LUT arithmetic; (2) CORDIC sacred routing with 6-stage continued fraction approximation; (3) Streaming argmax unit (<100 LUT); (4) Ternary BRAM storage with 2-bit packed weights; (5) Power-of-2 embedding lookup; (6) Ternary scheduler with φ-weighted round-robin; (7) ESP32 Wi-Fi JTAG; (8) OpenXC7 synthesis pipeline. Results: 19.6% LUT utilization, 0% DSP usage, 1.2W power on XC7A100T.

**Algorithm: Zero-DSP MAC**
```
Input: x ∈ {-1,0,+1}^n, w ∈ {-1,0,+1}^n
1: acc ← 0
2: for i = 0 to n-1 do
3:   if w[i] = +1 then acc ← acc + x[i]
4:   else if w[i] = -1 then acc ← acc - x[i]
5:   end if  // w[i] = 0: skip
6: end for
7: return acc
```

**Resource Utilization (XC7A100T):**
- LUT: 12,425 / 63,400 (19.6%)
- DSP: 0 / 240 (0%)
- BRAM: 45 / 210 (21.4%)
- Power: 1.2W @ 50MHz
